verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents provisioning GPU compute through the Cloud Console, Terraform, and a CKS API. The model is to create a managed Kubernetes cluster, add bare-metal Node Pools (including pay-as-you-go Spot Node Pools), then run workloads via a downloaded kubeconfig and kubectl, and the pricing page markets quickly spinning up on-demand capacity. This is a cluster-plus-node-pool workflow rather than a single standalone GPU instance, and nothing evidences the time from request to running code. Missing for 10: a documented single on-demand GPU instance launch from console or API, any provisioning-time or 'within minutes' evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a quick start.
